scope: Selected numerical observations from historical local runs, not new execution or a portable runtime reproduction package.
model_assumptions: Synthetic NZ9RAW1 Bayer input and functional ISP/codec/storage models.
External preparation byte 45A403E7=01 and selector byte 47F5AF45=01.
Direct MAIN mapping; factory loader and updater not executed.
The two external bytes are not part of the seven-instruction MAIN patch.
limitations: Raw run logs, memory windows, virtual cards, NEFs, model binaries and firmware are not bundled.
Receipt hashes identify retained source records; hashes alone do not prove their claims.
Single LibRaw decoder in the recorded route4 audit, not two independent decoder implementations.
Boot MCU input includes HALF=1/FULL=0; capture-stage initial released state was a separate observation.
No physical camera, sustained burst or retained pre-trigger-frame acceptance.
